title: Build a high-quality static “base frame” first (car interior + daylight +…
content:
Build a high-quality static “base frame” first (car interior + daylight + windshield glare + shallow depth of field/blurred city outside) in Freepik Spaces/ComfyUI, then use that as the visual foundation for Seedance 2.0.

Layer multiple product reference images (e.g., burger, fries, branded bag/logo) onto the base frame via reference nodes before sending the assembled frame into Seedance 2.0 to keep the SKU consistent in-hand/on-camera.

Use Seedance 2.0 to animate subtle realism (breathing, micro-expressions, natural body kinematics) from the static base frame + references instead of trying to prompt all motion explicitly.

Iterate clips by reusing the same final frame as the next starting point: final frame → swap in new product references → set new start/end frames → generate a new clip in Seedance.

Add speech after video generation with a separate voice API to “lock in” the realism (generate visuals in Seedance first, then overlay voice).
